title: predication-fibration
description: A cloven Grothendieck fibration over base parameters (L, C, E) whose every fiber is canonically the predication fiber algebra and whose reindexing functors are bilattice-residuated homomorphisms; equivalently a pseudo-coalgebra for the lax-idempotent fibration 2-comonad.

base.description: the fixed base parameters (L, C, E)

residuatedLattice.description: L, the integral commutative residuated lattice of truth values

predicateCategory.description: C, a small predicate category with finite limits, the base of the fibration

totalCategory.description: the total category E of the fibration

projection.description: p : E -> C, a cloven Grothendieck fibration (the cleavage gives chosen cartesian liftings)

fiberUniformity.description: (A1) for every q in C the fiber E_q = p^-1(q) is canonically isomorphic to the predication fiber algebra A_q = L^(E x E), as a thin category via its <=_k poset

generatorAction.description: (A2) for each of the four predicate-category generator classes (specialization, converse, subject-projection, object-projection) the reindexing functor f* acts on fiber elements by the specified cellwise reindexing

fiberStructurePreservation.description: (A3) every reindexing f* is a bilattice-residuated homomorphism, preserving meet_t, join_t, meet_k, join_k, negation, twist-product fusion, and twist-product right residual pointwise
